questions.q: Ajay is the sister of Vijay. Vijay is the father of Suresh. How is Ajay related to Suresh?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Paternal aunt. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Tree is to leaf as flower is to:
questions.why: Whole and its part. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
questions.why: The terms are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 squared plus 1. The next is 6 squared plus 1 = 37.

questions.q: Neha is 20th from the top and 23rd from the bottom in a class. How many students are in the class?
What comes next? CDE, EFG, GHI, IJK, …

questions.q: Thermometer is to temperature as seismograph is to:
questions.why: A seismograph records the ground movement caused by earthquakes.

questions.q: Mamlatdar is to Taluka as Collector is to:
questions.why: A Mamlatdar heads the revenue administration of a taluka; a Collector heads that of a district.
The first three are four-sided figures. A triangle has three sides.
